note: OpenAPI request extraction fixes: Result<Extractor, Rejection> arguments are documented like the bare extractor (required body / query / path / header params; Result<Validated<..>> still asserts garde::Validate); Option<Form<T>> and Result<Form<T>, _> on GET become query parameters; a Path<(..)> tuple longer than the route's own params (nest prefix) is aligned from the end; a parameter after a static prefix (/report-{year}) is documented, text after a parameter (/img/{name}.png, which axum cannot route) is a compile error, and escaped literal braces {{x}} are no longer a parameter (documented as %7Bx%7D).
